Package fr.cytech.safeexit.model.simulation

Class SimulationClock

java.lang.Object
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.simulation.SimulationClock
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class SimulationClock extends Object implements Serializable
Holds the timing parameters of the simulation: the interval between two cycles (in milliseconds) and whether the clock is running.

The clock itself does not schedule anything; the actual scheduling is done by the view (a JavaFX Timeline) or by a plain loop in command-line mode. Keeping the parameters here lets both modes share the same configuration.

Version:
1.0
Author:
GROUPE E
